spec.assertion: it.skip — no shield-damage StatKey and no shield entity on the v1 boss, so no assertion can discriminate a faithful model from its absence; belongs verbatim in `unmodeled`. Paired with a LIVE inertness test that no mari-cast buffApply carries a value near 100.09, which fails under the nearest-wrong 'smuggle it in as attackDamagePct/atkPct because the schema lacks a shield stat'.

buffApply stat pierceDamagePct exists, value === 40.99 raw (fails under a flat-resolved encoding), sole caster is mari (fails under a boss-debuff encoding with casterIdx null), distinct targetSlugs === roster size (fails under self-only targeting), expiresFrame finite (fails under a permanent no-durationSec encoding), and shrinking durationSec to 0.5s strictly lowers mari damage (fails if the buff is inert or the window length is not doing work).

gainPierce emits no event, so it is proven by differential: stripping every gainPierce effect strictly lowers mari damage (fails if pierce was dropped as defensive/inert), teammates stay byte-identical (fails under allies-scoped pierce), and patching hasPierce:true strictly INCREASES her damage (fails if the shipped model is a whole-fight boolean rather than a bounded 5s window — the over-credit nearest-wrong).

buffApply stat atkPct value 30.78 with targetSlug mari and casterIdx === targetIdx and finite expiresFrame (fails under a casterAtkPct encoding of the self branch, which would emit flat ATK); >=2 applications over 180s (fails under a trigger `passive` one-shot, since a 5s duration on a passive expires forever); and no atkPct 30.78 lands on a teammate (fails if the two skill2 branches are collapsed into one allies-scoped atkPct).

buffApply stat casterAtkPct from mari to every ally; value > 1000 and NOT 30.78 (fails under the atkPct nearest-wrong that scales each target's own ATK); exactly one distinct flat value across all targets with implied caster ATK in 10k..600k (fails if the value is target-scaled or highest-ally-scaled); >1 distinct expiresFrame (fails under a one-shot trigger). Cadence deliberately not pinned — see ALWAYS-⚑ note.

Formula-agnostic linearity: atkPct zeroed / shipped / doubled must give equal deltas within 2% and shipped > zeroed (fails if the line is missing, mis-magnituded, or non-linearly bucketed). Flipping noFb must move nothing (fails if the burst-cast nuke resolves inside the Full Burst window and takes the +50% major, contradicting the burst-lands-pre-FB fact). Zeroing it leaves teammates byte-identical (fails under an ally-scoped mis-target).

buffApply stat attackDamagePct value 40.99 cast by mari to every ally with finite expiresFrame (fails under self-only targeting or a permanent encoding), plus an inertness check that no atkPct 40.99 is emitted by mari (fails under the 'Attack damage read as ATK' nearest-wrong, which lands in the wrong bucket with different dilution).

⚑ The kit prose gives skill2 NO activation clause, so its interval / skill-cooldown length is not in the input domain (datamined only). No assertion pins a cadence; the tests assert only that the trigger REPEATS (>=2 applications in 180s), which discriminates interval-vs-passive without guessing a ⚑ value.

fixtures: controlComp('mari', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / mari / helm B3, boss Fire, focus mari; deterministic, no seed. 7 hoisted 180s runs: control + 6 counterfactuals (gainPierce stripped, hasPierce forced true, pierceDamagePct window cut to 0.5s, burst flatDamage zeroed, burst flatDamage doubled, burst noFb flipped). The B1+B2 supports are required so bursts actually cast. IMPORTANT FIXTURE CAVEAT: mari is Burst II and the fixture's crown is also Burst II, so stage 2 may be monopolised by crown and mari may never cast; both burst-slot groups are gated by a computed MARI_BURSTS flag (nuke-zeroing differential OR an attributable burstCast event) via it.skipIf, so a skip signals a needed mari-as-sole-B2 fixture rather than an override defect. Override counterfactuals go through a blocksOf() helper that accepts BOTH documented slot shapes (bare Block[] or CharacterSkills.blocks) so a patch can never silently no-op into a false green.
gaps: skill1a 'Damage dealt to Shield ▲100.09% for 3 sec' — it.skip: no shield-damage StatKey in the schema and the v1 boss has no shield, so the payload is unobservable; must be recorded in `unmodeled`. A live inertness test guards against it being smuggled in as a generic damage stat.

skill1a trigger 'landing a Full Charge attack' — even if a shield stat existed, the schema has no full-charge trigger kind (shotFired / chargeCounter{count:1} are the available proxies); untestable here because the effect is unobservable.

burst slot (both lines) — it.skipIf gated on MARI_BURSTS: mari is Burst II and competes with the fixture's crown for stage 2. If skipped, the burst lines are UNVERIFIED and need a comp whose only Burst II is mari.
skill2 cadence — the kit text supplies no activation clause; the interval/skill-CD length is a datamined ⚑ deliberately left unasserted (only trigger-repetition is proven).

All pierce DIFFERENTIAL assertions assume pierceDamagePct is live for pierce-tagged hits (per the gainPierce / flatDamage.pierce schema comments; types.ts still carries a 'parsed but inert in v1' comment on the stat). If the stat is genuinely inert, the event-level pierce assertions still hold and only the three damage-differential ones fall — that outcome is itself a finding about the stat, not about mari's model.
